text:
Ravi (CSM): Kickoff for BlueHarbor QBR planning — we have two weeks. Need slide owners, a delegated demo, and a small exec summary.
Ava (CS): I'll own the onboarding health slide + churn/usage signal snapshot. Will pull 30/60/90 metrics.
Elena (Product): I can do the product roadmap ask + risk mitigations (1 slide). Can someone give me the top 3 customer asks? @Olivia?
Olivia (AM): Top asks are: better latency SLO for dedicated, clearer cost breakdown for embeddings, and SSO for 3rd party apps. I'll DM specifics.
Marcus (Eng): Happy to support a one-slide tech posture (deploys, incidents, perf runs). Also volunteer to run the demo canary and capture the logs.
Ravi (CSM): Thanks — action list so far: Ava = onboarding health, Elena = product ask, Marcus = tech posture + demo, Olivia = cust asks + exec contacts. I'll do the exec summary + renewal risk heatmap.
Ava (CS): Quick note: onboarding NPS dropped from 9.1 to 7.4 in week 4. I'll include callouts and proposed enablement plan (2 workshops).
Elena (Product): Can you paste the three demo flows you want showcased? We should pick one that highlights caching and latency gains.
Olivia (AM): Pasting flow now: 1) Account creation -> embed search (long tail) 2) Real-time chat assistant with function call 3) Large-batch rerank job. Recommend we show flow 2 for exec impact.
Marcus (Eng): Demo plan: show cold start vs cached KV (30s -> 220ms), then a live request. I'll capture logs and a short snippet:
```
# demo commands (local)
export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
./run_demo --customer blueharbor --scenario realtime-chat
```
Ravi (CSM): Can we get slide drafts by EOD Friday? Also need a one-paragraph executive ask (2-3 bullets) for leadership to approve capacity commit.
Ava (CS): Slide draft ETA Friday 3pm. I'll attach the onboarding playbook delta and a 1-line risk summary.
Elena (Product): Roadmap slide draft Friday 4pm. Sending bullet list to @Ravi for language.
Marcus (Eng): Demo artifacts + perf logs uploaded to the shared drive by Friday 6pm. Will include runbook snippet and fallback behavior.
Olivia (AM): I'll prep the customer context + renewal timeline and send the exec contacts list.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR ready-checker scheduled for Monday 09:00 — all slides required 24h before.
Ravi (CSM): Noted. Two follow-ups: 1) Olivia, can you confirm if BlueHarbor requested a private deployment timeline? 2) Ava, please flag any enablement blockers that need engineering.
Olivia (AM): Confirmed — they asked about VPC/private in Q1. I'll add that to the exec ask.
Ava (CS): Flag: we need a cleaned sample dataset for workshops — ask to product/engineering to scrub and provide by next Wed.
Marcus (Eng): We can provide a sanitized dataset; will need exact fields list. Put request in this thread and tag me.
Ravi (CSM): Great — final quick checklist before Friday: 
- slide drafts in the drive (owners noted)
- demo runbook + perf logs uploaded
- exec one-pager (2 bullets)
- renewal risk heatmap + timeline
Please react with :thumbsup: when done.
Ava (CS): :thumbsup:
Elena (Product): :thumbsup:
Marcus (Eng): :thumbsup:
Olivia (AM): :thumbsup:
Ravi (CSM): Thanks team — I'll run the ready-check Monday and ping any gaps.
